name: High Scores
blurb: Manage a player's High Score list.
instructions:
# Instructions

Manage a game player's High Score list.

Your task is to build a high-score component of the classic Frogger game, one of the highest selling and most addictive games of all time, and a classic of the arcade era.
Your task is to write methods that return the highest score from the list, the last added score and the three highest scores.
starter_code:
# Get all scores
# Scores ? Scores
Scores ← |1 ⊙(⍤ "Please implement Scores" 0)

# Get the latest score
# Score ? Scores
Latest ← |1 ⊙(⍤ "Please implement Latest" 0)

# Get the top score
# TopScore ? Scores
PersonalBest ← |1 ⊙(⍤ "Please implement PersonalBest" 0)

# Get the top three scores
# TopThreeScores ? Scores
PersonalTopThree ← |1 ⊙(⍤ "Please implement PersonalTopThree" 0)
test_code:
~ "high-scores.ua" ~ Latest PersonalBest PersonalTopThree Scores

# List of scores?
⍤⤙≍ [30 50 20 70] Scores [30 50 20 70]

# Latest score?
⍤⤙≍ 30 Latest [100 0 90 30]

# Personal best?
⍤⤙≍ 100 PersonalBest [40 100 70]

# Personal top three from a list of scores?
⍤⤙≍ [100 90 70] PersonalTopThree [10 30 90 30 100 20 10 0 30 40 40 70 70]

# Personal top highest to lowest?
⍤⤙≍ [30 20 10] PersonalTopThree [20 10 30]

# Personal top when there is a tie?
⍤⤙≍ [40 40 30] PersonalTopThree [40 20 40 30]

# Personal top when there are less than 3?
⍤⤙≍ [70 30] PersonalTopThree [30 70]

# Personal top when there is only one?
⍤⤙≍ [40] PersonalTopThree [40]
source: Tribute to the eighties' arcade game Frogger
